faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Jhunjhunu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the various posts at Sainik School Jhunjhunu is 12th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for the Sainik School Jhunjhunu Various Posts?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You can download the application form from the official website and send it via speed post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for PGT posts at Sainik School Jhunjhunu is a 12th pass. Specific subject-related qualifications may also be required, as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TGT posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for TGT posts is between 21 to 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The Counsellor post offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 63758/- per month.

faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply online for these posts?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for these posts is offline only.
